matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: 10 mol% 5.5 nm BHO raises in-field Jc to 20.8 MA cm−2 at 1 T, 4.2 K and produces the highest lifting factor (10.9 at 1 T, 4.2 K) while keeping self-field Ic above 800 A/12 mm.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Geometric phase analysis reveals non-uniform εxx and εyy strain fields around BHO particles and Y248 intergrowths; these elastic strain regions create nanoscale potential landscapes that supplement core pinning, especially effective at low temperatures where coherence length is short.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Strain-related pinning contributes to the superior 5.5 nm BHO performance, shifting the peak normalized Jc (η) to higher fields (Bp ≈ 3 T at 4.2 K).

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Add 5–25 mol% excess Y in YBCO target to precipitate fine Y₂O₃ nano-particles that act as isotropic point-like pins, selectively boosting Jc when the field lies close to the ab-plane (θ≈90°).
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Produces a broad Jc peak at 85–90° and compensates the intrinsic mass anisotropy, cutting the anisotropy factor A from ~1.1 to <0.55 under 3 T, 77 K.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: VLS low-temperature liquid phase relaxes epitaxial strain during growth, limiting residual tensile stress that could crack thick films.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Enables crack-free 3.7 µm films with Tc ≈ 90.6 K, permitting full utilization of thickness-enhanced pinning potential without mechanical degradation.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Eliminate carbonate/oxalate precipitants to suppress BaCO3 formation; instead use NH3/H2O2 to precipitate Ba²⁺ as hydroxide and re-oxidize Ce³⁺→CeO2, creating a dual-phase BaCeO3+CeO2 nanocomposite that provides heterogeneous pinning sites.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Residual BaCO3 drops below XRD/Raman detection at 1000 °C; dual-phase mixture still acceptable for pinning since CeO2 is itself a known pinning oxide.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Use rapid cooling (10 °C/min) after 60 min anneal to freeze high-temperature cubic/rhombohedral polymorphs of BaCeO3, introducing local lattice mismatch strain fields that act as additional pinning centers without macroscopic film cracking.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Controlled thermal quench preserves nanoscale strain fields around BaCeO3/CeO2 inclusions, enhancing vortex pinning energy.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Fix Cu/Ba=1.19 and vary RE/Ba from 0.55 to 0.75; increasing RE/Ba increases (Gd,Yb)2O3 nanodot density but shortens BaCuO2 nanorods by hindering self-assembly, raising their diameter from 6.8 nm to 10 nm.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Creates layered REO nanodots that enhance ab-plane pinning; optimal RE/Ba=0.65 balances long nanorods and dense nanodots, yielding highest B*=551 mT and Fp=670 GN m⁻³ at 4 K.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Allow controlled elastic strain (≈3 % tensile in BCO, ≈-12 % compressive in REBCO) at coherent nanorod/matrix interfaces; strain fields drive self-assembly of nanorods along c-axis while avoiding plastic relaxation.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Strain field guides nanorod formation direction and prevents formation of misoriented precipitates, maintaining high pinning efficiency up to 14 T.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Increase BHO concentration from 5 mol% to 15 mol% to raise the density of 3D artificial pinning centers, compensating for the limited number of flux lines at low temperature and high field.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: At 30 K & 3 T, 15 mol% BHO yields 2.94-fold Jc enhancement versus pristine film; flux-pinning force reaches 4.9 GN m⁻³ at 4.2 K.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Select 6.5 nm BHO nanocrystals instead of 5.5 nm to avoid thermally driven coarsening that converts small unstable particles into fewer, larger pins with reduced pinning efficiency.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: 6.5 nm BHO films exhibit superior Jc at 0–1 T and 4.2–30 K; 5.5 nm BHO suffers coarsening, giving 15–20% lower absolute Jc under the same conditions.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Exploit nano-strain fields around coherent BHO particles to create additional local suppression of the order parameter, synergistically enhancing 3D flux pinning without introducing macroscopic residual stress that could crack the 1.5 µm thick film.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Contributes to the continuous rise of Fp with BHO content up to 15 mol% at 4.2 K, whereas at 77 K the optimal content is 10 mol% due to reduced elastic strain accommodation at higher temperature.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Stacking CPP (Y123+35 mol % Y211) over MPP (Y200+Y023) creates a compositional gradient that supplies extra Y211 nanoparticles to the growth front while the upper CPP layer buffers corrosive Ba–Cu–O liquid away from the seed.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Increases Y211/Y123 interface area → stronger flux pinning; lowers overall porosity from 25.1 % (MPP) to 18.1 % (C-MPP); eliminates 0.6 mm macro-cracks observed in MPP.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: CPP layer possesses higher green strength and lower melt viscosity than MPP, counteracting the thermal expansion mismatch and internal oxygen pressure that generate tensile stress and central bulging in MPP.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Flatter top surface, absence of 0.6 mm transverse cracks; improved shear resistance along a-b plane critical for dynamic Maglev loads.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Add nanosize BaCeO3 to supply Ce4+ in the melt; Ce segregates on Gd211 surfaces and suppresses Ostwald ripening, yielding finer Gd211 particles that provide stronger flux pinning.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Gd211 size decreases monotonically with BaCeO3 content; V211/d211 ratio rises, enhancing zero-field Jc and trapped field.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Ag2O addition and fine Gd211 dispersion reduce thermal-expansion mismatch stresses; total pushing of Gd211 in high-BaCeO3 samples creates local stress-free zones.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Minimises macro-cracking, allowing full 17.5 mm diameter single-grain bulks to survive magnetisation cycles.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Incorporate 10 % BaZrO3 into REBCO matrix to form insulating columnar defects that act as strong core-pinning sites, shifting the dominant pinning mechanism from δTc to δl with increasing field.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Raises irreversibility field and lift factor (~20 at 4.2 K, self-field), extends high-Js region to high temperature and high magnetic field.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Control lattice mismatch between BaZrO3 and REBCO to keep residual strain low, preventing crack formation in the 1.5 µm film.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Enables defect columns to remain continuous over hundreds of nanometres, sustaining high pinning density without film degradation.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Incorporation of 4 wt % BaZrO3 into YBCO matrix to create dense, c-axis-oriented nanorod defects that serve as strong artificial pinning centres.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Increases accommodation field B* and in-field Jc(B), but reduces zero-field Jc,0 due to shortened electron mean-free path; lowers MQE and raises NZPV at high T/B because pinning localises thermally activated flux flow (TAFF) and heat dissipation.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Exploits slight lattice mismatch between BZO nanorods and YBCO matrix to generate local strain fields around each defect.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Strain fields further enhance pinning potential, contributing to the observed increase in B* and reduced MQE by localising vortex motion.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Graded addition of 0–3.4 mol % BHO nanoparticles creates high-density APCs; higher BHO raises low-field Jc but slightly suppresses Tc (~1 K) via lattice strain/oxygen deficiency.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: 171 A/4-mm-w at 20 K, 18 T (3.1 µm, 2.7 mol % BHO); extrapolated 162 A/4-mm-w at 20 T.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Controlled oxygenation at 200–500 °C relieves lattice strain induced by BHO incorporation; low-temperature crystallization (800–840 °C) limits thermal mismatch with metal substrate.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Prevents film cracking in 200-m-long tapes; uniform Ic distribution (467 A/4-mm-w average at 77 K).

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Introduce BaHfO3 nanorod APCs into EuBCO layer to create strong correlated pinning for B//c-axis, selectively enhancing Jc at field angles where YBCO is weak.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: EuBCO+BHO tape shows higher Jc at θ = 0° (B//c) than pure YBCO, providing complementary angular dependence.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Exploit lattice mismatch (STO/MgO 7.4 %, CeO2/MgO 26 %) to introduce controlled misfit strain and dislocations inside the buffer; the strain field is partially transferred into YBCO, producing nanoscale elastic strain that supplements core pinning without elongating the YBCO c-axis or suppressing Tc.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Buffered samples retain Tc ≈ 89 K even at 100 Hz deposition, whereas YBCO on STO single crystal drops to 86.7 K; self-field Jc(77 K) stays above 2 MA cm⁻² for NC buffer.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: 6 mol% BHO doping introduces dense nanocolumns/nanoparticles that act as correlated and random pinning centers; splay angle increases with thickness, creating a 3-D pinning web.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Jc(B) decay slows at 4.2 K, yielding ≈ 5 MA/cm² at 14 T; Jc(θ) anisotropy reduced at 30 K, 5 T.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Multi-cycle deposition relaxes cumulative stress via intermittent thermal cycles; micro-strain rises only modestly from 0.21 % to 0.25 % when thickness triples.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Prevents crack formation and maintains mechanical integrity of thick coated conductor.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Co-doping 3.5 mol% BHO + 4.5 mol% BSO to form BaSnxHf1-xO3 solid-solution nanocolumns; Sn provides high nucleation density while Hf limits radial growth, yielding 5 nm diameter columns at 2200 µm-2.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Increases correlated pinning matching field to 4.6–4.7 T and introduces semi-coherent interfaces that generate extra random pinning sites.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Controlled micro-strain (0.29%) via epitaxial lattice mismatch between BSHO and EuBCO; strain drives formation of interfacial dislocations instead of macro-cracks.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Accommodates dopant-induced stress while avoiding current-blocking secondary-phase agglomerates.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Select moderate RE ion-size variance (Y0.8Gd0.1Yb0.1) to generate an optimal density of incidental (Y,Gd,Yb)2O3 nanoparticles without introducing excessive atomic disorder.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Yields ~1.5× higher Jc(20 K, 8 T) than pure YBCO; too high variance (Nd-containing) severely suppresses Jc despite more nanoparticles.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Keep average RE ionic radius equal to Y³⁺ to minimize macroscopic lattice strain while allowing controlled local strain fields around nanoparticles.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Prevents global lattice distortion that would otherwise degrade long-range coherence and Jc.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Add 30–50 % CeO2 into STO buffer to induce phase separation into CeO2 nanowalls; subsequent Ce diffusion reacts with YBCO to form BaCeO3 nanoparticles at the interface.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Nanoparticles serve as nucleation seeds that multiply threading screw dislocations, increasing areal density from 20 to 150 μm⁻².

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Exploit small lattice mismatch between YBCO and STO+CeO2 to maintain coherent growth while local strain fields around BaCeO3 precipitates drive dislocation formation.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Minimizes global residual stress, preventing film cracking, yet local strain concentrates at nanoparticles to nucleate dislocations.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Introduce 1.9–4.8 vol% coherent BaHfO3 inclusions that self-assemble into nanoparticles/nanorods, creating strong pinning centers with diameter ~2ξab–4ξab.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Jc at 1.8 K rises 3.2× (self-field) and 6.2× (5 T) versus undoped film; power-law exponent α drops from 0.58 to 0.22, confirming crossover to strong-pinning regime.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Exploit lattice mismatch between BHO and EuBCO to create localized strain fields around nanorods, supplementing core pinning.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Strain fields enhance pinning energy U0, but excessive BHO (>2.8 vol%) increases nanorod splay, facilitating double-kink excitations and faster creep (S rises from 0.015 to 0.025 at 30 K, 1 T).

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Employ a highly off-stoichiometric Y:Ba:Cu = 1:2:4 target to introduce excess Cu that substitutes on Ba sites and precipitates as nanoscale cubic domains.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Creates epitaxial non-superconducting domains that pin vortices without granular particles, raising JC by 150 % and Birr by 20 % at 80 K.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Use 40 nm thickness—above critical thickness—to fully relax epitaxial strain on STO, LAO and LSAT substrates.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Avoids strain-induced defect formation and ensures uniform distribution of cubic pinning centers throughout the film thickness.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Exploit small lattice mismatch between YBCO and STO+CeO2 to maintain coherent growth while local strain fields around BaCeO3 precipitates drive dislocation formation.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Lower Y content slightly contracts the YBCO lattice, compensating tensile thermal stress generated during cool-down from 870 °C to 20 K.

best_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Co-deposit 2.5 at.% Ba2YNbO6 + 2.5 at.% Ba2YTaO6 through a composite PLD target to form randomly distributed yet c-axis-oriented BYNTO nanocolumns that act as strong correlated pinning centres over a wide field range.
best_label_strategies.tuning effects: Nanocolumns provide continuous 1D pinning paths, raising Jc at intermediate fields; their diameter (5–16 nm) and meandering character optimise the matching field without severely depressing Tc.

best_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Pre-decorate the SrTiO3 substrate with PAD-synthesised ZrO2 nanoislands (375 µm^-2, 20 % coverage) to create heterogeneous nucleation sites that locally disrupt YBCO growth and seed dense stacking faults and Y248 intergrowths.
best_label_strategies.tuning effects: Generates abundant planar defects parallel to the ab-plane that act as isotropic high-field pins, improving Jc above 5 T and below 50 K while avoiding additional nanocolumn nucleation at the interface.

best_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Exploit lattice mismatch (16 %) between cubic ZrO2 and BYNTO to first form a thin compliant BaZrO3 interlayer, relaxing interfacial strain and enabling subsequent defect accommodation through misfit dislocations and stacking faults.
best_label_strategies.tuning effects: Local strain fields surrounding each nanoisland nucleate partial dislocations and stacking faults, creating strong point-like and planar pinning sites effective at high magnetic fields.

best_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Maintain high-temperature epitaxial PLD at 840 °C and 1.8 nm s^-1 on (001) STO to preserve sharp biaxial texture (FWHM 0.15°) despite high nanoparticle and defect densities.
best_label_strategies.tuning effects: Excellent crystalline alignment minimises weak-link grain boundaries, ensuring that added defects enhance pinning without introducing current-blocking high-angle boundaries.

best_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Combine both nanocolumnar (BYNTO) and nanoparticle (ZrO2-derived) pinning architectures in a single film, producing a multi-modal defect distribution that covers a broader range of vortex sizes and field orientations.
best_label_strategies.tuning effects: Absence of Fp(T,H) scaling evidences concurrent pinning mechanisms; stacking faults dominate at low-T/high-field while nanocolumns prevail at intermediate fields, yielding higher Jc above 9 T than either defect type alone.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Pre-formed BHO nanocrystals (3–10 nm) are added at 5–20 mol% to modulate the volume fraction and size distribution of non-superconducting pinning phases; smaller pristine sizes yield higher number density but suffer severe coarsening (6.3× for 3 nm), whereas 5.5 nm gives the smallest final size (7 ± 3 nm) and highest particle density (20.5e21 m−3), providing the most effective pinning centers.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: 10 mol% 5.5 nm BHO raises in-field Jc to 20.8 MA cm−2 at 1 T, 4.2 K and produces the highest lifting factor (10.9 at 1 T, 4.2 K) while keeping self-field Ic above 800 A/12 mm.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Introduce 2–5 mol% BaHfO₃ into EuBCO to form c-axis-inclined nano-rods that create strong correlated pinning along the c-axis, raising Jc(θ≈0°) and shifting the irreversibility field to higher values.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Enhances low-field Jc by ~2× at 65 K, 3 T, B∥c and enlarges the usable B–T window for motor applications.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Add 5–25 mol% excess Y in YBCO target to precipitate fine Y₂O₃ nano-particles that act as isotropic point-like pins, selectively boosting Jc when the field lies close to the ab-plane (θ≈90°).
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Produces a broad Jc peak at 85–90° and compensates the intrinsic mass anisotropy, cutting the anisotropy factor A from ~1.1 to <0.55 under 3 T, 77 K.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Systematic increase of Zr content (5–25 mol%) in precursor to form BaZrO3 nanorods and suppress BaCuO2 nanorods.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: BaZrO3 number density rises to 2.2e3 rods µm−2; BaCuO2 peak intensity drops 20-fold, eliminating vertical nanorods above 10 mol% Zr.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Eliminate carbonate/oxalate precipitants to suppress BaCO3 formation; instead use NH3/H2O2 to precipitate Ba²⁺ as hydroxide and re-oxidize Ce³⁺→CeO2, creating a dual-phase BaCeO3+CeO2 nanocomposite that provides heterogeneous pinning sites.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Residual BaCO3 drops below XRD/Raman detection at 1000 °C; dual-phase mixture still acceptable for pinning since CeO2 is itself a known pinning oxide.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Fix RE/Ba=0.65 and vary Cu/Ba from 1.15 to 1.21; only Cu/Ba=1.19 yields dense, vertically aligned (011)-BaCuO2 nanorods, while higher Cu forms CuO/RECuO2 surface precipitates that block nanorod growth.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Maximizes c-axis-correlated pinning centers; Jc(4 K, 5 T) reaches 13.2 MA cm⁻² and power-law exponent α drops to 0.39.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Fix Cu/Ba=1.19 and vary RE/Ba from 0.55 to 0.75; increasing RE/Ba increases (Gd,Yb)2O3 nanodot density but shortens BaCuO2 nanorods by hindering self-assembly, raising their diameter from 6.8 nm to 10 nm.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Creates layered REO nanodots that enhance ab-plane pinning; optimal RE/Ba=0.65 balances long nanorods and dense nanodots, yielding highest B*=551 mT and Fp=670 GN m⁻³ at 4 K.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Systematic addition of BaO2 up to 4 wt % in SEG-211 precursor to enrich Ba content and suppress RE/Ba substitution.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Tc(onset) rises from 92.65 K to 94.57 K and ΔTc narrows by 71 % to 0.88 K; self-field Jc(77 K) increases 31 % to 33.55 kA cm−2.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Co-doping 10 wt % Ag2O with the optimized BaO2 level to introduce molten Ag that releases oxygen and modifies local atmosphere.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Increase BHO concentration from 5 mol% to 15 mol% to raise the density of 3D artificial pinning centers, compensating for the limited number of flux lines at low temperature and high field.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: At 30 K & 3 T, 15 mol% BHO yields 2.94-fold Jc enhancement versus pristine film; flux-pinning force reaches 4.9 GN m⁻³ at 4.2 K.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Select 6.5 nm BHO nanocrystals instead of 5.5 nm to avoid thermally driven coarsening that converts small unstable particles into fewer, larger pins with reduced pinning efficiency.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: 6.5 nm BHO films exhibit superior Jc at 0–1 T and 4.2–30 K; 5.5 nm BHO suffers coarsening, giving 15–20% lower absolute Jc under the same conditions.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Stacking CPP (Y123+35 mol % Y211) over MPP (Y200+Y023) creates a compositional gradient that supplies extra Y211 nanoparticles to the growth front while the upper CPP layer buffers corrosive Ba–Cu–O liquid away from the seed.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Increases Y211/Y123 interface area → stronger flux pinning; lowers overall porosity from 25.1 % (MPP) to 18.1 % (C-MPP); eliminates 0.6 mm macro-cracks observed in MPP.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Random substitution of 20 % Y by Nd/Sm/Gd introduces local lattice-parameter mismatch and stacking faults, generating δκ-type pinning centres without lowering Tc.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Jc remains field-independent up to 8.5 T; Fp,max ≈ 40 N cm-3 at 77 K and 2.9e3 N cm-3 at 10 K with Bp ≈ 7–8 T.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Add nanosize BaCeO3 to supply Ce4+ in the melt; Ce segregates on Gd211 surfaces and suppresses Ostwald ripening, yielding finer Gd211 particles that provide stronger flux pinning.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Gd211 size decreases monotonically with BaCeO3 content; V211/d211 ratio rises, enhancing zero-field Jc and trapped field.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Dissolved Ce and Ba from BaCeO3 alter Ba/Gd substitution level in Gd123 lattice, creating point-defect (chemical) pinning centres; excess Ce reduces Tc while optimal level maximizes secondary peak in Jc-B.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Non-monotonic Tc and Jc(B) behaviour; secondary peak shifts to lower B as substitution decreases, enabling high in-field Jc.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Incorporate 10 % BaZrO3 into REBCO matrix to form insulating columnar defects that act as strong core-pinning sites, shifting the dominant pinning mechanism from δTc to δl with increasing field.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Raises irreversibility field and lift factor (~20 at 4.2 K, self-field), extends high-Js region to high temperature and high magnetic field.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Graded addition of 0–3.4 mol % BHO nanoparticles creates high-density APCs; higher BHO raises low-field Jc but slightly suppresses Tc (~1 K) via lattice strain/oxygen deficiency.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: 171 A/4-mm-w at 20 K, 18 T (3.1 µm, 2.7 mol % BHO); extrapolated 162 A/4-mm-w at 20 T.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Co-deposit 2.5 at.% Ba2YNbO6 + 2.5 at.% Ba2YTaO6 through a composite PLD target to form randomly distributed yet c-axis-oriented BYNTO nanocolumns that act as strong correlated pinning centres over a wide field range.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Nanocolumns provide continuous 1D pinning paths, raising Jc at intermediate fields; their diameter (5–16 nm) and meandering character optimise the matching field without severely depressing Tc.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Combine both nanocolumnar (BYNTO) and nanoparticle (ZrO2-derived) pinning architectures in a single film, producing a multi-modal defect distribution that covers a broader range of vortex sizes and field orientations.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Absence of Fp(T,H) scaling evidences concurrent pinning mechanisms; stacking faults dominate at low-T/high-field while nanocolumns prevail at intermediate fields, yielding higher Jc above 9 T than either defect type alone.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Introduce BaHfO3 nanorod APCs into EuBCO layer to create strong correlated pinning for B//c-axis, selectively enhancing Jc at field angles where YBCO is weak.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: EuBCO+BHO tape shows higher Jc at θ = 0° (B//c) than pure YBCO, providing complementary angular dependence.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: 6 mol% BHO doping introduces dense nanocolumns/nanoparticles that act as correlated and random pinning centers; splay angle increases with thickness, creating a 3-D pinning web.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Jc(B) decay slows at 4.2 K, yielding ≈ 5 MA/cm² at 14 T; Jc(θ) anisotropy reduced at 30 K, 5 T.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Co-doping 3.5 mol% BHO + 4.5 mol% BSO to form BaSnxHf1-xO3 solid-solution nanocolumns; Sn provides high nucleation density while Hf limits radial growth, yielding 5 nm diameter columns at 2200 µm-2.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Increases correlated pinning matching field to 4.6–4.7 T and introduces semi-coherent interfaces that generate extra random pinning sites.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Select moderate RE ion-size variance (Y0.8Gd0.1Yb0.1) to generate an optimal density of incidental (Y,Gd,Yb)2O3 nanoparticles without introducing excessive atomic disorder.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Yields ~1.5× higher Jc(20 K, 8 T) than pure YBCO; too high variance (Nd-containing) severely suppresses Jc despite more nanoparticles.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Add 30–50 % CeO2 into STO buffer to induce phase separation into CeO2 nanowalls; subsequent Ce diffusion reacts with YBCO to form BaCeO3 nanoparticles at the interface.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Nanoparticles serve as nucleation seeds that multiply threading screw dislocations, increasing areal density from 20 to 150 μm⁻².

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Introduce 3–5 equi-atomic RE elements at the RE site to raise configurational entropy (ΔSmix = 1.10–1.60 R), promoting nanoscale stacking-fault formation that act as strong flux-pinning centers.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Reduce Y content from stoichiometric 1.0 to 0.9 to increase growth supersaturation, which refines BHO nanorod diameter and raises nanorod number density from 2.1e3 to 3.5e3 μm-2.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Finer and denser nanorods enhance correlated pinning, lifting Jc at 20 K, 9 T by ~40 % relative to Y1.0 film.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Eliminate carbonate/oxalate precipitants to suppress BaCO3 formation; instead use NH3/H2O2 to precipitate Ba²⁺ as hydroxide and re-oxidize Ce³⁺→CeO2, creating a dual-phase BaCeO3+CeO2 nanocomposite that provides heterogeneous pinning sites.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Residual BaCO3 drops below XRD/Raman detection at 1000 °C; dual-phase mixture still acceptable for pinning since CeO2 is itself a known pinning oxide.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Fix RE/Ba=0.65 and vary Cu/Ba from 1.15 to 1.21; only Cu/Ba=1.19 yields dense, vertically aligned (011)-BaCuO2 nanorods, while higher Cu forms CuO/RECuO2 surface precipitates that block nanorod growth.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Increase BHO concentration from 5 mol% to 15 mol% to raise the density of 3D artificial pinning centers, compensating for the limited number of flux lines at low temperature and high field.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: At 30 K & 3 T, 15 mol% BHO yields 2.94-fold Jc enhancement versus pristine film; flux-pinning force reaches 4.9 GN m⁻³ at 4.2 K.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Select 6.5 nm BHO nanocrystals instead of 5.5 nm to avoid thermally driven coarsening that converts small unstable particles into fewer, larger pins with reduced pinning efficiency.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: 6.5 nm BHO films exhibit superior Jc at 0–1 T and 4.2–30 K; 5.5 nm BHO suffers coarsening, giving 15–20% lower absolute Jc under the same conditions.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Stacking CPP (Y123+35 mol % Y211) over MPP (Y200+Y023) creates a compositional gradient that supplies extra Y211 nanoparticles to the growth front while the upper CPP layer buffers corrosive Ba–Cu–O liquid away from the seed.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Increases Y211/Y123 interface area → stronger flux pinning; lowers overall porosity from 25.1 % (MPP) to 18.1 % (C-MPP); eliminates 0.6 mm macro-cracks observed in MPP.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Random substitution of 20 % Y by Nd/Sm/Gd introduces local lattice-parameter mismatch and stacking faults, generating δκ-type pinning centres without lowering Tc.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Jc remains field-independent up to 8.5 T; Fp,max ≈ 40 N cm-3 at 77 K and 2.9e3 N cm-3 at 10 K with Bp ≈ 7–8 T.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Add nanosize BaCeO3 to supply Ce4+ in the melt; Ce segregates on Gd211 surfaces and suppresses Ostwald ripening, yielding finer Gd211 particles that provide stronger flux pinning.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Gd211 size decreases monotonically with BaCeO3 content; V211/d211 ratio rises, enhancing zero-field Jc and trapped field.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Dissolved Ce and Ba from BaCeO3 alter Ba/Gd substitution level in Gd123 lattice, creating point-defect (chemical) pinning centres; excess Ce reduces Tc while optimal level maximizes secondary peak in Jc-B.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Non-monotonic Tc and Jc(B) behaviour; secondary peak shifts to lower B as substitution decreases, enabling high in-field Jc.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Incorporation of 4 wt % BaZrO3 into YBCO matrix to create dense, c-axis-oriented nanorod defects that serve as strong artificial pinning centres.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Increases accommodation field B* and in-field Jc(B), but reduces zero-field Jc,0 due to shortened electron mean-free path; lowers MQE and raises NZPV at high T/B because pinning localises thermally activated flux flow (TAFF) and heat dissipation.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Graded addition of 0–3.4 mol % BHO nanoparticles creates high-density APCs; higher BHO raises low-field Jc but slightly suppresses Tc (~1 K) via lattice strain/oxygen deficiency.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: 171 A/4-mm-w at 20 K, 18 T (3.1 µm, 2.7 mol % BHO); extrapolated 162 A/4-mm-w at 20 T.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Combine both nanocolumnar (BYNTO) and nanoparticle (ZrO2-derived) pinning architectures in a single film, producing a multi-modal defect distribution that covers a broader range of vortex sizes and field orientations.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Absence of Fp(T,H) scaling evidences concurrent pinning mechanisms; stacking faults dominate at low-T/high-field while nanocolumns prevail at intermediate fields, yielding higher Jc above 9 T than either defect type alone.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Introduce BaHfO3 nanorod APCs into EuBCO layer to create strong correlated pinning for B//c-axis, selectively enhancing Jc at field angles where YBCO is weak.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: EuBCO+BHO tape shows higher Jc at θ = 0° (B//c) than pure YBCO, providing complementary angular dependence.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: 6 mol% BHO doping introduces dense nanocolumns/nanoparticles that act as correlated and random pinning centers; splay angle increases with thickness, creating a 3-D pinning web.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Jc(B) decay slows at 4.2 K, yielding ≈ 5 MA/cm² at 14 T; Jc(θ) anisotropy reduced at 30 K, 5 T.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Co-doping 3.5 mol% BHO + 4.5 mol% BSO to form BaSnxHf1-xO3 solid-solution nanocolumns; Sn provides high nucleation density while Hf limits radial growth, yielding 5 nm diameter columns at 2200 µm-2.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Increases correlated pinning matching field to 4.6–4.7 T and introduces semi-coherent interfaces that generate extra random pinning sites.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Select moderate RE ion-size variance (Y0.8Gd0.1Yb0.1) to generate an optimal density of incidental (Y,Gd,Yb)2O3 nanoparticles without introducing excessive atomic disorder.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Yields ~1.5× higher Jc(20 K, 8 T) than pure YBCO; too high variance (Nd-containing) severely suppresses Jc despite more nanoparticles.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Add 30–50 % CeO2 into STO buffer to induce phase separation into CeO2 nanowalls; subsequent Ce diffusion reacts with YBCO to form BaCeO3 nanoparticles at the interface.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Nanoparticles serve as nucleation seeds that multiply threading screw dislocations, increasing areal density from 20 to 150 μm⁻².

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Introduce 3–5 equi-atomic RE elements at the RE site to raise configurational entropy (ΔSmix = 1.10–1.60 R), promoting nanoscale stacking-fault formation that act as strong flux-pinning centers.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Sample 2#-EuGdYEr attains the highest self-field Jc = 373 kA cm-2 at 4.2 K and retains >10 kA cm-2 at 5 T, correlating with 98 % SC volume fraction and dense SFs.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Select RE combinations avoiding La (prone to Ba-site substitution) to suppress local Tc degradation; instead use Eu/Gd/Y/Er/Nd mixtures that keep Tc > 90 K.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Eliminates La-induced weak links; samples without La show narrower superconducting transitions and higher SC volume fractions.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Reduce Y content from stoichiometric 1.0 to 0.9 to increase growth supersaturation, which refines BHO nanorod diameter and raises nanorod number density from 2.1e3 to 3.5e3 μm-2.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Finer and denser nanorods enhance correlated pinning, lifting Jc at 20 K, 9 T by ~40 % relative to Y1.0 film.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Introduce 1.9–4.8 vol% coherent BaHfO3 inclusions that self-assemble into nanoparticles/nanorods, creating strong pinning centers with diameter ~2ξab–4ξab.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Jc at 1.8 K rises 3.2× (self-field) and 6.2× (5 T) versus undoped film; power-law exponent α drops from 0.58 to 0.22, confirming crossover to strong-pinning regime.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Employ a highly off-stoichiometric Y:Ba:Cu = 1:2:4 target to introduce excess Cu that substitutes on Ba sites and precipitates as nanoscale cubic domains.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Creates epitaxial non-superconducting domains that pin vortices without granular particles, raising JC by 150 % and Birr by 20 % at 80 K.

matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: 10 mol% 5.5 nm BHO raises in-field Jc to 20.8 MA cm−2 at 1 T, 4.2 K and produces the highest lifting factor (10.9 at 1 T, 4.2 K) while keeping self-field Ic above 800 A/12 mm.

matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: High self-field Ic (>800 A/12 mm) is retained at 77 K for 5 mol% BHO, while textured growth allows full utilization of aligned pinning centers under applied field.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Introduce 2–5 mol% BaHfO₃ into EuBCO to form c-axis-inclined nano-rods that create strong correlated pinning along the c-axis, raising Jc(θ≈0°) and shifting the irreversibility field to higher values.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Enhances low-field Jc by ~2× at 65 K, 3 T, B∥c and enlarges the usable B–T window for motor applications.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Add 5–25 mol% excess Y in YBCO target to precipitate fine Y₂O₃ nano-particles that act as isotropic point-like pins, selectively boosting Jc when the field lies close to the ab-plane (θ≈90°).
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Produces a broad Jc peak at 85–90° and compensates the intrinsic mass anisotropy, cutting the anisotropy factor A from ~1.1 to <0.55 under 3 T, 77 K.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Systematic increase of Zr content (5–25 mol%) in precursor to form BaZrO3 nanorods and suppress BaCuO2 nanorods.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: BaZrO3 number density rises to 2.2e3 rods µm−2; BaCuO2 peak intensity drops 20-fold, eliminating vertical nanorods above 10 mol% Zr.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Eliminate carbonate/oxalate precipitants to suppress BaCO3 formation; instead use NH3/H2O2 to precipitate Ba²⁺ as hydroxide and re-oxidize Ce³⁺→CeO2, creating a dual-phase BaCeO3+CeO2 nanocomposite that provides heterogeneous pinning sites.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Residual BaCO3 drops below XRD/Raman detection at 1000 °C; dual-phase mixture still acceptable for pinning since CeO2 is itself a known pinning oxide.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Employ nano-sized, phase-pure crystallites that can be dispersed in REBCO precursor inks; during REBCO epitaxy these particles align with the matrix c-axis, creating columnar or random nanoparticle arrays that preserve biaxial texture of the superconducting film.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Absence of BaCO3 prevents texture degradation, allowing transferred REBCO film to maintain high in-plane and out-of-plane alignment.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Fix RE/Ba=0.65 and vary Cu/Ba from 1.15 to 1.21; only Cu/Ba=1.19 yields dense, vertically aligned (011)-BaCuO2 nanorods, while higher Cu forms CuO/RECuO2 surface precipitates that block nanorod growth.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Maximizes c-axis-correlated pinning centers; Jc(4 K, 5 T) reaches 13.2 MA cm⁻² and power-law exponent α drops to 0.39.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Fix Cu/Ba=1.19 and vary RE/Ba from 0.55 to 0.75; increasing RE/Ba increases (Gd,Yb)2O3 nanodot density but shortens BaCuO2 nanorods by hindering self-assembly, raising their diameter from 6.8 nm to 10 nm.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Creates layered REO nanodots that enhance ab-plane pinning; optimal RE/Ba=0.65 balances long nanorods and dense nanodots, yielding highest B*=551 mT and Fp=670 GN m⁻³ at 4 K.

matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Enhances low-field Jc by ~2× at 65 K, 3 T, B∥c and enlarges the usable B–T window for motor applications.

matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Produces a broad Jc peak at 85–90° and compensates the intrinsic mass anisotropy, cutting the anisotropy factor A from ~1.1 to <0.55 under 3 T, 77 K.

matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Maximizes c-axis-correlated pinning centers; Jc(4 K, 5 T) reaches 13.2 MA cm⁻² and power-law exponent α drops to 0.39.

matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Creates layered REO nanodots that enhance ab-plane pinning; optimal RE/Ba=0.65 balances long nanorods and dense nanodots, yielding highest B*=551 mT and Fp=670 GN m⁻³ at 4 K.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Stacking CPP (Y123+35 mol % Y211) over MPP (Y200+Y023) creates a compositional gradient that supplies extra Y211 nanoparticles to the growth front while the upper CPP layer buffers corrosive Ba–Cu–O liquid away from the seed.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Increases Y211/Y123 interface area → stronger flux pinning; lowers overall porosity from 25.1 % (MPP) to 18.1 % (C-MPP); eliminates 0.6 mm macro-cracks observed in MPP.

matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Jc remains field-independent up to 8.5 T; Fp,max ≈ 40 N cm-3 at 77 K and 2.9e3 N cm-3 at 10 K with Bp ≈ 7–8 T.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Add nanosize BaCeO3 to supply Ce4+ in the melt; Ce segregates on Gd211 surfaces and suppresses Ostwald ripening, yielding finer Gd211 particles that provide stronger flux pinning.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Gd211 size decreases monotonically with BaCeO3 content; V211/d211 ratio rises, enhancing zero-field Jc and trapped field.

matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Non-monotonic Tc and Jc(B) behaviour; secondary peak shifts to lower B as substitution decreases, enabling high in-field Jc.

matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Raises irreversibility field and lift factor (~20 at 4.2 K, self-field), extends high-Js region to high temperature and high magnetic field.

matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: 10 mol% 5.5 nm BHO raises in-field Jc to 20.8 MA cm−2 at 1 T, 4.2 K and produces the highest lifting factor (10.9 at 1 T, 4.2 K) while keeping self-field Ic above 800 A/12 mm.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Geometric phase analysis reveals non-uniform εxx and εyy strain fields around BHO particles and Y248 intergrowths; these elastic strain regions create nanoscale potential landscapes that supplement core pinning, especially effective at low temperatures where coherence length is short.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Strain-related pinning contributes to the superior 5.5 nm BHO performance, shifting the peak normalized Jc (η) to higher fields (Bp ≈ 3 T at 4.2 K).

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Exploit nanoscale lattice mismatch between BaZrO3 and REBCO to create local strain fields that modulate oxygen content and enhance pinning.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Tc decreases linearly from 88.4 K to 86.1 K with 25 mol% Zr; strain-induced oxygen vacancies provide additional pinning sites.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Eliminate carbonate/oxalate precipitants to suppress BaCO3 formation; instead use NH3/H2O2 to precipitate Ba²⁺ as hydroxide and re-oxidize Ce³⁺→CeO2, creating a dual-phase BaCeO3+CeO2 nanocomposite that provides heterogeneous pinning sites.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Residual BaCO3 drops below XRD/Raman detection at 1000 °C; dual-phase mixture still acceptable for pinning since CeO2 is itself a known pinning oxide.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Use rapid cooling (10 °C/min) after 60 min anneal to freeze high-temperature cubic/rhombohedral polymorphs of BaCeO3, introducing local lattice mismatch strain fields that act as additional pinning centers without macroscopic film cracking.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Controlled thermal quench preserves nanoscale strain fields around BaCeO3/CeO2 inclusions, enhancing vortex pinning energy.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Fix RE/Ba=0.65 and vary Cu/Ba from 1.15 to 1.21; only Cu/Ba=1.19 yields dense, vertically aligned (011)-BaCuO2 nanorods, while higher Cu forms CuO/RECuO2 surface precipitates that block nanorod growth.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Maximizes c-axis-correlated pinning centers; Jc(4 K, 5 T) reaches 13.2 MA cm⁻² and power-law exponent α drops to 0.39.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Fix Cu/Ba=1.19 and vary RE/Ba from 0.55 to 0.75; increasing RE/Ba increases (Gd,Yb)2O3 nanodot density but shortens BaCuO2 nanorods by hindering self-assembly, raising their diameter from 6.8 nm to 10 nm.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Creates layered REO nanodots that enhance ab-plane pinning; optimal RE/Ba=0.65 balances long nanorods and dense nanodots, yielding highest B*=551 mT and Fp=670 GN m⁻³ at 4 K.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Allow controlled elastic strain (≈3 % tensile in BCO, ≈-12 % compressive in REBCO) at coherent nanorod/matrix interfaces; strain fields drive self-assembly of nanorods along c-axis while avoiding plastic relaxation.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Strain field guides nanorod formation direction and prevents formation of misoriented precipitates, maintaining high pinning efficiency up to 14 T.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Increase BHO concentration from 5 mol% to 15 mol% to raise the density of 3D artificial pinning centers, compensating for the limited number of flux lines at low temperature and high field.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: At 30 K & 3 T, 15 mol% BHO yields 2.94-fold Jc enhancement versus pristine film; flux-pinning force reaches 4.9 GN m⁻³ at 4.2 K.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Select 6.5 nm BHO nanocrystals instead of 5.5 nm to avoid thermally driven coarsening that converts small unstable particles into fewer, larger pins with reduced pinning efficiency.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: 6.5 nm BHO films exhibit superior Jc at 0–1 T and 4.2–30 K; 5.5 nm BHO suffers coarsening, giving 15–20% lower absolute Jc under the same conditions.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Exploit nano-strain fields around coherent BHO particles to create additional local suppression of the order parameter, synergistically enhancing 3D flux pinning without introducing macroscopic residual stress that could crack the 1.5 µm thick film.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Contributes to the continuous rise of Fp with BHO content up to 15 mol% at 4.2 K, whereas at 77 K the optimal content is 10 mol% due to reduced elastic strain accommodation at higher temperature.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Relieving interfacial stress between LMO and YBCO by matching lattice constants through oxygen annealing, reducing thermal and lattice mismatch-induced defects.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Enables defect-free epitaxial layer-by-layer growth of YBCO, enhancing superconducting current transport capability.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Stacking CPP (Y123+35 mol % Y211) over MPP (Y200+Y023) creates a compositional gradient that supplies extra Y211 nanoparticles to the growth front while the upper CPP layer buffers corrosive Ba–Cu–O liquid away from the seed.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Increases Y211/Y123 interface area → stronger flux pinning; lowers overall porosity from 25.1 % (MPP) to 18.1 % (C-MPP); eliminates 0.6 mm macro-cracks observed in MPP.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Add nanosize BaCeO3 to supply Ce4+ in the melt; Ce segregates on Gd211 surfaces and suppresses Ostwald ripening, yielding finer Gd211 particles that provide stronger flux pinning.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Gd211 size decreases monotonically with BaCeO3 content; V211/d211 ratio rises, enhancing zero-field Jc and trapped field.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Dissolved Ce and Ba from BaCeO3 alter Ba/Gd substitution level in Gd123 lattice, creating point-defect (chemical) pinning centres; excess Ce reduces Tc while optimal level maximizes secondary peak in Jc-B.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Non-monotonic Tc and Jc(B) behaviour; secondary peak shifts to lower B as substitution decreases, enabling high in-field Jc.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Ag2O addition and fine Gd211 dispersion reduce thermal-expansion mismatch stresses; total pushing of Gd211 in high-BaCeO3 samples creates local stress-free zones.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Minimises macro-cracking, allowing full 17.5 mm diameter single-grain bulks to survive magnetisation cycles.

matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Raises irreversibility field and lift factor (~20 at 4.2 K, self-field), extends high-Js region to high temperature and high magnetic field.

matched_label_strategies.tuning strategies: Control lattice mismatch between BaZrO3 and REBCO to keep residual strain low, preventing crack formation in the 1.5 µm film.
matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Enables defect columns to remain continuous over hundreds of nanometres, sustaining high pinning density without film degradation.

matched_label_strategies.tuning effects: Produces a broad Jc peak at 85–90° and compensates the intrinsic mass anisotropy, cutting the anisotropy factor A from ~1.1 to <0.55 under 3 T, 77 K.
